title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers-no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With 30 offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at  verve.com .

Verve is a global ad-tech company that owns and operates a fully integrated advertising stack, spanning demand, supply, and data. While most companies in our space specialize in one layer of the ecosystem, we own the DSP, the SSP, and the data and identity infrastructure that connects them. This means our technology works end to end, in real time, every time a user opens an app or loads a screen.

We reach 2.5 billion consumers across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Our platform processes billions of signals daily, enabling advertisers to plan and execute campaigns with precision and publishers to manage and monetize their inventory effectively. As the digital advertising landscape shifts away from walled gardens and third-party identifiers, Verve is focused on building the infrastructure that supports a more open, accountable internet. That is what drives the work we do.

We’re building the Monetization Trust & Safety Operations team to ensure OpenAI can grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable-for users, advertisers, and the business. This team sits at the intersection of operational scale, product risk, and rapid revenue growth, designing systems and operations that enable ads to scale without compromising user trust or safety. We’re looking for a senior operator with strong analytical instincts to help build and scale Monetization Trust & Safety Operations at OpenAI. title: Staff Product Manager, Search Experiences
description:
Why Mozilla ?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Search is the most essential functionality in any browser, and it’s evolving daily with new interaction paradigms, AI-powered answers, and agentic browsing. The Firefox Desktop Search team owns one of Mozilla ’s most critical product areas, delivering high-quality, privacy-respecting search experiences that help solve key user problems, differentiate Firefox, and drive long-term business value.

This role will help shape Firefox’s strategy in an era where AI is redefining how people search, learn, and get things done online.

As a Staff Product Manager, you will define and drive the strategy and execution for search within the Firefox Desktop browser across Windows, macOS, and Linux. You will help determine how Firefox integrates traditional web search with emerging AI capabilities while upholding Mozilla ’s leadership in privacy and user agency. You will operate at the intersection of product experience, revenue growth, and partner strategy to ensure Firefox delivers differentiated, future-facing search experiences.

What you’ll do:

• Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for search features in the Firefox Desktop browser, driving search engagement and revenue.

• Lead end-to-end experimentation across browser search access points, default search experiences, and search suggestions.

• Define clear success metrics in partnership with Data Science, and translate insights into actionable decisions.

• Partner with Business Development to support search partnerships and ensure product execution aligns with contractual and strategic commitments.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Research, and Design to prototype and ship innovative search experiences.

• Navigate complex trade-offs between user experience, privacy principles, technical constraints, and revenue outcomes in a rapidly shifting search landscape.

• Contribute to quarterly and annual planning, identifying risks, opportunities, and long-term strategic initiatives.

What you’ll bring:

• 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of revenue-impacting and user-facing product areas.

• Experience working on search, discovery, AI/ML-powered products, or adjacent domains.

• Strong understanding of modern AI capabilities and their product implications.

• Proven experience leading experimentation programs and driving measurable business outcomes.

• Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools and SQL.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing without direct authority.

• Demonstrated ability to balance user needs, privacy considerations, and business objectives.

• Excellent communication skills and comfort engaging with senior stakeholders.

What you’ll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

description:
🌍 Hello World!
We are The Codest - International Tech Software Company with tech hubs in Poland delivering global IT solutions and projects. Our core values lie in “Customers and People First” approach that prioritises the needs of our customers and a collaborative environment for our employees, enabling us to deliver exceptional products and services.
Our expertise centers on web development, cloud engineering, DevOps and quality. After many years of developing our own product - Yieldbird, which was honored as a laureate of the prestigious Top25 Deloitte awards, we arrived at our mission: to help tech companies build impactful product and scale their IT teams through boosting IT delivery performance. Through our extensive experience with product development challenges, we have become experts in building digital products and scaling IT teams.
But our journey does not end here - we want to continue our growth. If you’re goal-driven and looking for new opportunities, join our team! What awaits you is an enriching and collaborative environment that fosters your growth at every step.
💡 The project:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Platform Engineer (full-time or part-time).
Own the production system end-to-end. Today the entire stack runs self-hosted on Docker Compose: a custom-built lighttpd with database-driven virtual hosts, MariaDB, a Kubo IPFS node, Dozzle for logs, and Uptime Kuma for monitoring. There is no CI/CD pipeline, no infrastructure-as-code, no application performance monitoring, and the scaling story is vertical for now. Your job is to keep the lights on, automate the manual work, design how this system scales, and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions on cloud services (load balancing, object storage, managed databases) as we grow.
Requirements
📈 Responsibilities:

• Operate the production system: deploys, rollbacks, capacity, incident response.

• Design and execute the scaling roadmap - horizontal scaling, load balancing, caching layers, object-storage offload, database replication, IPFS-node fan-out.

• Evaluate and integrate cloud building blocks (managed databases, object storage, CDN, load balancers) where they earn their cost.

• Stand up CI/CD pipelines (greenfield - likely GitHub Actions) covering test, build, image push, and deploy across all services.

• Establish observability: metrics, logs, error tracking, SLOs, and meaningful alerts.

• Manage TLS / ACME automation, DNS, and secrets handling - replace today's hardcoded credentials with a proper secret-management story.

• Introduce infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or comparable) so the production system is reproducible.

• Use AI coding assistants to author IaC modules, runbooks, and incident-response playbooks.

🔑 Tech Stack You'll Work With or Introduce:

• Docker, Docker Compose, image building.

• Linux (Debian-style), Bash, Python for scripting.

• Lighttpd today (niche, with DB-driven vhost logic you'll learn) - likely to be reconsidered as we scale.

• MariaDB - including replication, backup/restore drills, performance tuning.

• Kubo IPFS node, private-swarm operation, gateway scaling.

• Let's Encrypt / ACME / Certbot.

• Load-balancing layer (to be chosen - HAProxy, Caddy, NGINX, ALB/NLB, etc.).

• Object storage (to be chosen - S3, GCS, R2, MinIO; mainly for non-IPFS payloads and backups).

• CI/CD (likely GitHub Actions, to be confirmed).

• Observability stack (likely Prometheus + Grafana + Loki + Sentry - to be introduced).

• IaC: Terraform or Ansible (to be introduced).

• One of AWS / GCP / Azure as the long-term cloud target - tbd

Hard Skills - Must-Have:

• 5+ years professional Linux sysadmin / DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering.

• Docker fluency: writing, debugging, and optimizing Dockerfiles and multi-service compose stacks.

• Networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, HTTP semantics, reverse proxies, load balancers.

• Scripting: Bash plus at least one of Python (or similar like Go/Ruby).

At Huzzle , we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We’re hiring on behalf of a growing international business working with clients across multiple markets.
The company is looking for an experienced Account Executive who can take qualified B2B opportunities through the final stages of the sales process, build strong relationships with decision-makers, negotiate confidently, and consistently convert opportunities into new business.
Job Summary
As an Account Executive, you’ll own qualified sales opportunities from the initial handoff through discovery, proposal, negotiation, closing, and transition to the delivery team.
This is a closing-focused role for someone who knows how to build on an existing sales conversation rather than starting from scratch. You’ll be expected to quickly understand the prospect’s needs, communicate the value of the solution, handle objections, protect pricing, and move opportunities toward a clear decision.
You’ll work with international B2B clients and have significant ownership over your pipeline and results.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced B2B Account Executive, Sales Executive, or B2B Sales Closer who is comfortable managing high-value opportunities and working independently in a remote environment.
Key Responsibilities

• Take ownership of qualified B2B sales opportunities from handoff through to close.

• Build on existing prospect conversations and maintain continuity throughout the sales process.

• Lead sales meetings, discovery conversations, proposal discussions, negotiations, and closing calls.

• Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and senior stakeholders.

• Handle objections around pricing, competition, timing, value, and internal approval processes.

• Confidently communicate and defend commercial terms without unnecessarily discounting.

• Identify opportunities to move deals forward and proactively manage next steps.

• Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline stages, activity, and deal forecasts.

• Keep prospects engaged throughout the buying process.

• Work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition after a successful close.

• Take ownership of your sales targets, pipeline, activity, and overall commercial performance.

Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales and closing experience, ideally working with international clients.

• Proven experience closing meaningful, high-value B2B deals.

• A track record of taking qualified opportunities from meeting through to signed agreement.

• Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and consultative selling.

• Excellent negotiation and objection-handling skills.

• Commercial confidence and the ability to protect value during price negotiations.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent CRM discipline and pipeline management.

• Ability to produce professional sales proposals quickly, ideally within 48 hours.

• Highly self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability for sales outcomes.

• Comfortable operating without relying heavily on scripts or constant supervision.

• Experience selling services, SaaS, technology, consulting, or other complex B2B solutions is an advantage.

title: Associate Attorney
description:
Join Tyson & Mendes - Where Insurance Defense Meets Innovation

Associate Attorney

Please note: An active bar license in the State of California is required.

At Tyson & Mendes, we’re more than a national litigation firm-we’re a force for change in insurance defense and trial advocacy. Known for our cutting-edge approach and our bold mission to stop Nuclear Verdicts®, we set the standard for results-driven representation across the country.

We’re growing fast-and looking for sharp, motivated attorneys who want to do meaningful work, win in the courtroom, and be part of a firm that’s redefining legal excellence.

Why Tyson & Mendes?

Elevate Your Career - We don’t just talk about growth-we build it in. Our attorneys benefit from advanced trial training, ongoing mentorship, and clear pathways for advancement. Your success is our investment.

Stability with Momentum - We’ve achieved national scale while preserving a collaborative, people-first culture. Join a team that values long-term impact over short-term wins.

Diversity Drives Us - We go beyond checking boxes. At Tyson & Mendes, diverse perspectives aren’t just welcomed-they’re essential. We foster a workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and celebrated.

Work Where You Thrive - Office, home, or hybrid-we offer flexible arrangements designed around performance and balance, not rigid policies.

Who You Are

You are driven to win and defend justice with integrity, courage, and precision. Strategic and confident in your approach, you navigate complex legal challenges with a clear, defense-minded perspective. You follow the rules while thinking several steps ahead-like any strong litigator should. Passionate about trial work and dedicated to exceptional client service, you strive to make a meaningful impact in every case. You’re also eager to grow, collaborate, and contribute to a high-performing legal team that values excellence, inclusion, and innovation.

Make Your Move. Be part of something bigger-join Tyson & Mendes and help shape the future of insurance defense. Apply today. We’re ready for your best.

Responsibilities

• Develop compelling case strategies that cut through emotional arguments and drive results

• Set a higher standard-challenge mediocrity and push for excellence in every aspect of your work

• Independently manage court appearances, depositions, motion practice, and trials

title: Accounts Receivable Analyst
description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.
Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.
Our Mission
People who live with cancer - those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it - are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.
Our Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for the collection of client receivables in accordance with contractual agreements. This includes review, maintenance and resolution of disputes, review of Clinical Trial revenue and expenses, review of study accounts receivable aging, patient accounts and pass through invoices, study finance trackers, patient trackers and contracts, as well as interaction with various departments in order to determine the validity of charges as well as the collection of those charges from sponsors.
Additionally, this position provides assistance to the Finance and Budget & Contracts departments on specifically identified projects and tasks listed below. This often involves analyzing multiple documents and often complex data to determine collectability of receivables.
This is a fully remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.
Duties include but are not limited to:

• Monitor assigned accounts: review aging, look for irregularities, non-payments, and delayed payments in customer accounts

• Contact Sponsors/CROs via phone to follow on unpaid/open invoices and ensure timely payments are received

• Investigate and resolve sponsor, patient and customer disputes

• ​Maintaining a strong business relationship with the Sponsors/CROs as the primary contact and voice for Sarah Cannon Research Institute in regards to payment of receivables

• Reconcile financial study data with data provided by Sponsors/CROs as needed.

• Review, interpret and discuss contracts internally and with clients to assist with resolving payment or dispute issues

• Review medical procedure invoices in relation to the contracts to determine eligibility for reimbursement of costs

• Identify, report on and work with supervisor to resolve trends that negatively impact payment or workflows

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

- Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling.

- The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last

- Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team.

- A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job.

- Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments.

- Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment.

- Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking.

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. Janea Systems (USA) is a dynamic team of the best & brightest software engineering specialists and solutions innovators, from around the world. From kernel to cloud, we provide high-impact software development services to Fortune 500 companies.

We are seeking an exceptionally talented Lead Machine Learning Engineer to join our rapidly growing consulting team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable machine learning and AI systems for enterprise clients.
You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and production software engineering , helping transform cutting-edge ML research into robust, production-grade solutions. As a Lead ML Engineer, you will guide ML architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact AI solutions across multiple industries.
Location
Fully Remote/ European Residence required
Compensation
Salary
Work Schedule
Full time/ Flexible working hours
Reports to
Head of Engineering
Member of
Engineering Team
To be considered for this position, you must have the following qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or applied AI.

• 3+ years of experience in technical leadership or mentoring engineering teams.

• Strong experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments.

• Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.

• Experience designing scalable ML systems and data pipelines.

• Strong programming skills in Python and experience with backend or distributed systems.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Experience with containerization and deployment technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Strong understanding of MLOps practices and model lifecycle management.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in remote environments.

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

• Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

Ideal candidates will also have:

• Experience working with LLMs, generative AI systems, or deep learning architectures.

• Experience building ML platforms or internal AI tooling.

• Familiarity with distributed training and large-scale data processing frameworks.

• Experience with feature stores, model monitoring, and ML observability tools.

• Experience delivering ML solutions in client-facing consulting environments.

Why join Janea? Because world-class talent deserves world-class opportunities. What we offer:

• Competitive compensation with benefits, paid vacation, and sick leave.

• The opportunity to work with a globally diverse team of top engineering talent on the industry’s toughest engineeringchallenges.

• Ultra-flexible working conditions - we provide a generous office equipment allowance so you can work from home, we can also provide you with a desk at an office/coworking facility near you, or use both. No business travel necessary.

• An enjoyable, start-up work environment, with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.

• Flexible working hours - as a remote-first company, our focus has always been on getting the job done well, not when or where it gets done.

YOU BRING

title: Senior Site Reliability and DevOps Engineer
description:
Build reliable, resilient cloud platforms that keep critical financial services running.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability and DevOps Engineer to join the SRE team within our growing Corporate Action Processing group. You will bring 7+ years of relevant technology experience, including strong AWS and DevOps expertise, alongside an analytical approach to identifying issues and driving them through to resolution.

This is a hands-on engineering role spanning both Site Reliability Engineering and DevOps. On the SRE side, you will help ensure services remain available, reliable and stable as changes, upgrades and new functionality are introduced. On the DevOps side, you will help evolve the platform through new technology, automation and engineering improvements.

As the team continues to expand globally, you will play an important role in supporting its success while taking ownership of solutions from design through to operation.

What You’ll Do

• Proactively identify operational, performance, security and availability constraints and bottlenecks, recommending and implementing opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Partner with engineering teams to support onboarding, advocate for engineering best practices, troubleshoot platform outages and develop improvement actions that strengthen service reliability.

• Support application teams in delivering highly available and reliable services, including participation in 24x7 on-call production support.

• Manage and maintain CI pipelines within GitLab, deployments to AWS through Jenkins, and infrastructure through code, while helping progress delivery towards continuous deployment.

• Work with engineering teams to design, build, implement and support platform solutions using AWS and other cloud technologies, taking ownership from design through to operation.

What We’re Looking For

• 7+ years of relevant technology experience, including at least 3 years working with AWS and practical knowledge of services such as EC2, Auto Scaling Groups (ASG), S3 and RDS.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and CloudFormation, together with infrastructure configuration tools such as Chef.

• Working knowledge of Git, including branching models and merge strategies, and experience supporting CI/CD engineering practices.

• Working knowledge of PowerShell/PowerShell Core for automation and the ability to apply automation to improve operational efficiency and platform consistency.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering teams to identify issues, support resolution and improve platform reliability.

Bonus Points For

• Experience working with additional AWS services including ECS, EKS, API Gateway and Lambda.

• Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.

• Working knowledge of both Windows and Linux administration.

• Experience with observability and monitoring technologies including Datadog, Splunk and Application Performance Monitoring (APM), including dashboarding.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.

• Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

• Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

• Comprehensive Benefits Coverage - 100% company-paid health, life, and disability insurance effective from Day 1 of employment.

• Retirement Savings Program - Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with the option of receiving a matching employer contribution.

• Virtual Health Care & EFAP - Company-paid virtual health care and Employee & Family Assistance Program support for employees and their dependents/pa

description:

By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

We’re looking for a high-energy, hands-on Senior Revenue Accountant who has significant experience with reviewing B2B SaaS sales contracts, managing appropriate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, and participating in day-to-day billing and revenue accounting activities. The ideal candidate thinks strategically on a process level and also executes in the details.  They are comfortable using core systems and tools and think automation first when designing process. #LI-MH1

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Talent Acquisition team is responsible for building the leadership bench that powers Anduril's mission. Executive Recruiting owns the searches that shape the company's most senior hires - the leaders who run Anduril's commercial, operational, financial, legal, and people functions. As Anduril scales from a growth-stage defense technology company into a generational platform, the quality of its SG&A leadership becomes a defining competitive advantage. The Executive Recruiter, SG&A is responsible for running the searches that build this leadership layer, partnering with the C-suite to identify, attract, and close the senior executives who will scale Anduril's corporate functions to match the complexity and ambition of the business.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an Executive Recruiter to join our team in Costa Mesa, CA . In this role, you will be responsible for owning executive hiring across Anduril's SG&A function, including VP level and senior leadership roles. You will partner directly with Anduril's leadership team to run full-cycle searches, build a proprietary network of senior cleared defense talent, and represent Anduril credibly to candidates at the general officer, senior acquisition, and executive industry levels. This will require deep working knowledge of the DoD acquisition ecosystem, established relationships across the ex-military-turned-industry community, and the executive presence to drive process alongside C-level stakeholders. If you are someone who can operate with autonomy, build the systems that turn founder-led referrals into a rigorous pipeline, and earn trust quickly with senior candidates, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own full-cycle executive searches across SG&A functions - Finance, Legal, People, Communications, and other corporate leadership roles - from intake through close, with a particular emphasis on VP-and-above positions.

title: Content Moderator, Trust and Safety
description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

•
Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.

• We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

• Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY

• We do our best work by being CURIOUS

• We grow by remaining DYNAMIC

• Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

• At the heart of great partnerships we’ll always find EMPATHY

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE
The Senior Content Specialist is the experienced professional responsible for reviewing flagged and reported content, making final enforcement decisions within an established policy framework, and owning the customer conversation when those decisions are appealed. Automated systems catch a large share of policy violations, but this role exists to catch what the system gets wrong, and to hold the line where it's right. This is a journey-level Trust & Safety position requiring independent judgment, sound written communication, and comfort operating with real autonomy on complex, sensitive cases.
WHY DO WE WANT YOU
We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.
WHAT WILL YOU DO

• Work the content moderation queue: review flagged content against the actual material rather than relying solely on automated summaries, verify claims, and factor in the distinct weight of automated flags vs. multiple human reports

• Decide and act at the appropriate scope, from removing a single item to disabling a full account or workspace, using the standard reason taxonomy and maintaining a clear audit trail for every decision

• Own the customer conversation end to end: take handoffs from front-line support, evaluate appeals against what's actually on record, and write responses yourself, including denials and final-decision notices that cite the specific policy section, without disclosing investigative detail

• Process refunds or related account actions where policy windows apply

• Maintain a full decision log with supporting reasoning, and mark confirmed false positives so recurring issues stop re-flagging

• Triage sensitive and high-severity content categories using organizational guidelines, escalating genuinely ambiguous cases and immediately escalating anything meeting the threshold for mandatory reporting

• Recognize coordinated abuse patterns across multiple accounts, distinguishing genuine bad-actor networks from legitimate accounts affected by report-bombing

• Handle data export and account recovery requests, denying them cleanly when policy requires

• Diagnose non-abuse issues that surface in the queue (system false positives, technical breakage) and route them to the right team with supporting detail already gathered

• Improve the system, not just the queue: refine customer-facing response templates, surface false-positive patterns, and flag policy gaps to your manager

• Exposure to disturbing material is part of the job, including content flagged for explicit, graphic, hateful, or exploitative content

• The most difficult content is often the content that gets appealed; you may review the same case more than once, weighing a customer's argument against the original decision

• Sustainable pacing and support matter: this role requires the ability to flag when a case is affecting you and a manager who treats that as normal

• Decisions are asymmetric in consequence: an incorrect removal costs a legitimate customer their work, while an incorrect restoration can put real harm back on a live platform

• Some content and context will be intentionally restric

title: DTV

About the role

The Image Direction Specialist is responsible for executing real-time switching and on-air control within SportyNet’s digital television environment. This professional works inside the channel’s switcher/control room, ensuring seamless transitions, correct execution of breaks, insertion of graphics and promos, and maintaining the integrity of the broadcast signal.

Acting as a key link between Production, MCR, Engineering, and Programming, the Switcher Room Operator ensures that every on-air output matches the channel’s technical, editorial, and timing requirements.

 

What you'll be doing

Live Switching & On-Air Execution

• Operate switcher/control room systems during live shows, continuity blocks, replays, and special broadcasts

• Execute transitions, cuts, wipes, and on-air graphic elements according to the rundown or control-room cues

• Trigger commercial breaks, promos, channel IDs, and sponsored content at precise timing

• Follow instructions from directors, producers, and technical supervisors during live broadcasts

Technical Signal Monitoring & On-Air Quality Control

• Monitor outgoing program feed for video quality, audio consistency, sync, and timing accuracy

• Identify and respond quickly to black frames, freeze frames, audio drops, misfires, or graphic errors

• Ensure redundancy paths and backup signals are ready and functional

• Run pre-show checks to verify all on-air elements (graphics, feeds, VTs, transitions)

Coordination with MCR, Production & Editorial Teams

• Maintain constant communication with MCR for playlist execution, timing conflicts, and late changes

• Work with Production to ensure all assets (VTs, promos, lower-thirds, bugs) are ready and loaded

• Collaborate with Programming to confirm break timing, revised schedules, and last-minute adjustments

• Support the editorial team during breaking news or unexpected content switches

Switcher Room Setup & Technical Preparation

• Prepare sources, inputs, keyers, DSKs, and macros required for each show or continuity block

• Verify routing of cameras, vMix sources, graphic systems, server outputs, and remote feeds

• Load and confirm correct graphic templates, transitions, and overlays

• Coordinate with Engineering for switcher updates, troubleshooting, and configuration checks

Commercial & Promo Insertions

• Execute commercial breaks with accurate timing, following programming logs and MCR instructions

• Ensure promos, branded moments, sponsorships, and bumpers fire correctly and completely

• Report any misfires or discrepancies to MCR and Programming

Workflow Documentation & Operational Discipline

• Maintain detailed logs of on-air issues, operator actions, and technical alerts

• Follow SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for switcher room operation

• Ensure clean and organized operation stations, routing sheets, and control interfaces

• Participate in rehearsals, pilots, and simulations for new shows or technical upgrades

 

What you'll bring

• Degree or technical training in Broadcasting, Audiovisual Production, Media Engineering, or related fields

• Experience operating switcher/control room systems in TV, live production, or digital broadcast

• Familiarity with studio control rooms, MCR environments, and broadcast workflows

• Experience with live sports broadcasts is a strong advantage

• Proficiency with broadcast switchers and control-room automation systems

• Understanding of signal routing, SDI/IP workflows, multiviewers, and video server operations

• Knowledge of audio/video standards, color, sync, and on-air timing

• Familiarity with graphic systems (CG, overlays, bugs, lower-thirds)

• Ability to troubleshoot under pressure and respond to live broadcast incidents

• Intermediate English for documentation and communication with vendors

 

What's in it for you

• We have an office in São Paulo City!

title: Fashion Design to UX Design Career Changer
description:
About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.
